title: Google Shopping Products - Prices, Merchants & Changes
description: Minimal input: {"queries": ["wireless headphones"], "maxResultsPerSource": 3}. Cost is $0.015 per parsed page plus $0.002 per delivered product. Empty monitoring/filter results still incur page fees. Set maxTotalChargeUsd in Apify run options for a monetary cap.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Product keywords, for example ["wireless headphones"]. Up to 50 queries. Each successfully parsed page costs $0.015 and each delivered product costs $0.002.

maxResultsPerSource.title: Maximum delivered rows per source
maxResultsPerSource.description: Maximum rows delivered per query/channel after filters and monitoring, for example 50. A source can return fewer. Duplicates are removed across this run.

country.title: Google market
country.description: Search market: us (USD), gb (GBP), de/fr (EUR), ca (CAD) or au (AUD). For example "gb" requests UK offers. Currency is read from the displayed price; no currency conversion. Queries use English interface text.

merchants.title: Merchant names
merchants.description: Keep merchant names containing any entry, case-insensitive; for example ["Best Buy"]. Empty means any merchant. Filtering adds no fee; parsed pages still cost $0.015.

minPrice.title: Minimum displayed price
minPrice.description: Minimum numeric displayed price in that market, for example 20. Zero disables the bound. A source "from" price is compared by its displayed minimum, without shipping or tax.

maxPrice.title: Maximum displayed price
maxPrice.description: Maximum numeric displayed price in that market, for example 100. Zero disables the bound. Filters run before row billing; parsed pages are still billed.

onlyNewOrChanged.title: Only new or changed offers
onlyNewOrChanged.description: true compares title/merchant product identity and price text/currency with previously delivered rows under monitorKey. First run delivers matches; later runs emit new or changed prices with previous_price. Default false. Unchanged checks still pay parsed-page fees.

titleContains.title: Title includes any
titleContains.description: Keep titles containing at least one phrase, case-insensitive; for example ["wireless"] or ["math"]. Empty means any title. Applied before row billing; successful page checks are still billed.

titleExcludes.title: Title excludes any
titleExcludes.description: Drop titles containing any phrase, case-insensitive; for example ["case"] or ["trailer"]. Empty disables exclusions. Dropped rows are not billed; parsed pages are.

monitorKey.title: Monitor name
monitorKey.description: Name for persistent delivered-row history, for example "daily-competitors". Use 1–60 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Reuse with the same target list and filters; change it for a new baseline. Keeps the latest 50,000 delivered IDs.

excludeIds.title: Previously collected IDs
excludeIds.description: Skip exact output id values, for example ["a-previous-id"]. Up to 10,000. An optional alternative to persistent monitoring; excluded rows are not billed but parsed pages are.

maxPagesPerSource.title: Maximum pages per source
maxPagesPerSource.description: Safety cap on successful page reads per query/channel, for example 5. Maximum 50. Every parsed page costs $0.015, including filtered/unchanged pages. The result limit can stop sooner. Source pagination does not guarantee complete coverage.
